name: Update Log Party Record 2 Choice
definition: Specifies the details related to an update of an individual record in the static data of a party.

Address.name: Address
Address.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address.

ContactDetails.name: Contact Details
ContactDetails.definition: Specifies the contact details of the party.

OpeningDate.name: Opening Date
OpeningDate.definition: Specifies the opening date of the party.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Specifies the closing date of the party.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type classification of the party.

TechnicalAddress.name: Technical Address
TechnicalAddress.definition: Unique technical address to unambiguously identify a party for receiving messages from the executing system.

MarketSpecificAttribute.name: Market Specific Attribute
MarketSpecificAttribute.definition: Additional attributes defined by a central security depositary for a party.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Specifies the name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

ResidenceType.name: Residence Type
ResidenceType.definition: Specifies the type of residence where the party has its permanent home or principal establishment.

LockStatus.name: Lock Status
LockStatus.definition: Specifies whether the party is locked or not, and the reason for this status, when required.

Restriction.name: Restriction
Restriction.definition: Defines the specific processing characteristics for a party to ensure configurability of specific requirements, as prescribed by national legal and regulatory requirements and practices.
